newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish troops kill 47 Kurdish rebels in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkish troops kill 47 Kurdish rebels in clashes.

text.p: Turkish troops killed 47 Kurdish rebels in air and land operations across eastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Wednesday, as a government offensive ground on for a third day.

A statement from the governor's office said 15 separatist fighters of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in the province of Sirnak and another 15 in the remote mountainous province of Tunceli, scene of some of the heaviest fighting.
Seventeen others were killed in a series of clashes around the largely-Kurdish southeast, heartland of the PKK's 12-year insurgency for self-rule from Ankara.

State-run Anatolian news agency said two members of the armed forces and four members of the state-paid village guard militia were killed in three days of fighting. Earlier, security sources put the total government losses at 10.
The Turkish armed forces stepped up operations against the PKK on Monday, with airplanes and attack helicopters assaulting the rebels' remote mountain redoubts.
The head of the general staff, Ismail Hakki Karadayi, and senior force commanders went to the region on Tuesday.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in Turkey in the separatist insurgency.
